blurb: This check verifies that the LDAP client refreshes user and group caches in less than a day. DISA STIG V-215205 requires usercachetimeout and groupcachetimeout in /etc/security/ldap/ldap.cfg to both be present, uncommented, and no greater than 900 seconds; any value above 900 lets the client hold stale user or group entries for a day or more. When LDAP authentication is not required the requirement is Not Applicable.
